services.heading: Care that comes to the home.
services.lede: Scheduled visits from registered nurses and trained carers, with named supervision and a written record of every visit.

plans.heading: Three levels of cover.
plans.lede: From a dependable weekday routine to continuous, high-dependency care. Every plan includes a written report after each visit.
plans.footnote: Prices are base monthly subscriptions in Ghana Cedis and exclude prescribed medication, consumables and specialist equipment hire.

pledge.heading: Help us get to 1 February.
pledge.body: Every pledge goes directly into the pilot: device kits for partner clinics, the offline sync layer, and onboarding the first cohort of care teams.
